units.rawText: Huh?! The coffee was just so sweet you zoned out for a sec? That's it?!!

units.rawText: You're spacing out, Professor. Something on your mind? Hmm... Honestly, when things get tough, sleeping is the only good solution I know.

units.rawText: Sleep it off and you'll forget all your troubles and feel way more relaxed. That's not running away. It's just a buffer before you pick yourself back up. Life goes on, after all...
